description: Optional reminders without the app sending anything itself: a calendar file (.ics) built on the phone, or on Android a Google Calendar link the parent taps. The calendar app sends the reminders.
offer_when: Fast start step 3: practice series (2–5 sessions) + day-4 check-in
Day-4 check-in, "Keep going": 4 more sessions + first weekly check-in

trial_practice.title_and_notes: From modules.json > trial for the chosen module and age band. Repeat rule built from the days: FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=n if consecutive, otherwise FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=...;COUNT=n.
trial_practice.notes_suffix: Open the coach app for tips.

trial_checkin.title: Coach: how did it go? (2 min)
trial_checkin.notes: Open the coach app and tap "How did it go?".

weekly_checkin.title: Coach: weekly check-in (5 min)
weekly_checkin.notes: Open the coach app and tap "Weekly check-in".

privacy_note: Calendar entries only say "Coach" and the activity, never anything about your child or your answers. They may sync to your calendar provider (for example Google or Apple).

after_download.ios: Tap the downloaded file, then 'Add All'.
after_download.android: Open the downloaded file with your calendar app. If your calendar can't open it, set a weekly reminder yourself: we'll show you the day and time you picked.
after_download.update: If the plan changes, old calendar entries stay. The parent can delete them in their calendar.

tech_notes: Generate the .ics as a Blob and download it with an <a download> link: no network request, so it works with connect-src 'none'. Use the phone's local time zone (TZID). Test on both iPhone (Safari and installed app) and Android before the friend launch.
android_method: Android: one Google Calendar link per entry (calendar.google.com, action=TEMPLATE with title, times, notes and repeat). Tapped by the parent, opens the Google Calendar app or website. Fallback: the .ics file. Intent links did not work (Chrome only opens apps that accept web links).
